{"id":185949,"tenderTitle":"LEO CONSTELLATIONS REAL-TIME RADIO RESOURCE MANAGEMENT DEMONSTRATOR - EXPRO PLUS","tenderNumber":"1-13458","tenderDescription":"To develop an active antenna combined software and hardware demonstrator representative of a LEO satellite payload by exploiting advanced strategies for real time dynamically managing radio resources.Description: On-board satellite resource allocationstrategiesare essential for managing the distribution of limited resources from the antennas to multiple user terminals. These strategies involve dynamic allocation techniques that can adjust in real-time based on traffic demand. However, in dense traffic scenarios like onboard LEO satellites, these strategies face significant challenges.
